scope: Prestige family Allure preview surfaced by the official Prestige selected-preset listing; rendered read-only browser evidence only; selected preset mapping unresolved.

sources.observation: Activating View demo opened a storefront branded Prestige - Allure; this does not establish that it is the current selected Prestige preset.

claims.observed: Rendered pages expose a campaign-led homepage, 65-product category with density/sort/filter controls, product gallery and supporting product/story modules, and a simple empty-cart route.
claims.risk: Page structure does not establish visual hierarchy or working behavior, and the store is branded Allure rather than the current selected Prestige preset.
claims.vsn_guard: Record as Prestige-family evidence only; validate exact theme/preset mapping and actual interactions before counting it against the selected cohort.

claims.observed: Sample storefront shows leather, origin, sustainability, delivery, return, discount and review statements.
claims.risk: These are merchant statements and were not independently validated.
claims.vsn_guard: Require merchant evidence, market scope and current policy before using trust claims.
